question: Where do the PDFs of a building live?

question: Can one PDF page serve several levels?
answer: No. One page belongs to exactly one level.

question: What does the Building takeoff do for a missing PDF?
answer: Use the saved summary and show a warning.
reason: User answer 2026-10-31.

question: How does a riser connect levels?

reason: User answer 2026-10-31.

question: Must the web app support buildings?
answer: Only if cheap. Desktop-first is acceptable. Do not put much effort into web. A backend such as Supabase may be considered.
reason: User answer 2026-10-31. Director recommendation: no backend; the saved summaries let web run takeoff from the building file.

question: [data model/rule] Where is the building stored?

options.label: A file the user places, with summary files beside it.
A per-install registry (localStorage or app data), as in the old app.
A hosted backend.

reason: Matches D-B-01 and D-B-05. B cannot be shared. C adds the AGPL network duty and a service to run.

question: [data model/rule] Where do the sheet summaries go?

options.label: One file per project (one PDF), <projectUuid>.summary.json, beside the building file, flat in the folder.
All inside the building file.
A summaries sub-folder (needs fs:allow-mkdir).

reason: B grows to tens of MB and each Save rewrites it. C needs a new permission; the B1-T16 spike may show it is cheap, so a switch to C stays allowed.

question: [data model/rule] Where does the document id (projectUuid) live?

options.label: In the embedded project JSON (schema v22).
In the PDF catalog.
Both.

reason: No engine change. The id travels with the project that already travels in the PDF.

question: [data model/rule] Old multi-page files saved all elements on page 0, and what does Save As do with the id? Pick an answer for both parts, for example "A and A".

options.label: Part 1: keep elements on page 0 and say so in the release note. Part 2: Save As makes a new id.
Part 1: ask at open. Part 2: Save As makes a new id.
Part 1: keep on page 0. Part 2: Save As keeps the id.

reason: Part 1: the app cannot know the page. Part 2: a copy with the same id breaks the sheet link.

question: [data model/rule] A run that touches a riser changes its network type. What happens?

options.label: The riser type changes and the runs on all levels retag (open documents at once, closed ones as a pending op).
The app refuses the change and tells the user to detach the riser first.
Only the run changes (breaks rules.md section 3, not allowed).

reason: Rule 2: the whole connected run changes. B is the cheap first release if the pending queue is late.

question: [data model/rule] Is "same x and y on every level" in page units (pt)?

options.label: Yes, with a check of page size, rotation and scale; if different, attach refuses with a message.
Real-world mm from each page scale.

reason: Two sheets from one CAD model share the pt frame. B needs both pages calibrated. Not verified: that your sheets share one page size.

question: [data model/rule] Has a riser a flow direction and a source level?

options.label: Stored on the riser (flow, sourceLevelId), you set them, default unknown.
Derived from the equipment (needs routing start-stamp data, not verified).
None.

reason: Cheap and explicit. The takeoff never sums flow across levels.

question: [data model/rule] A circuit has terminals on several levels. How does the takeoff treat the vertical cable?

options.label: Add no vertical length and write a warning for such a circuit.
Add the vertical part from the elevation difference of the levels.

reason: MepApp counts no cable length today. B needs a rule for routing in a shaft.

question: One workbook or one per level?

options.label: One workbook with provenance columns.
One workbook per level.

reason: The xlsx writer needs no change.

question: Does web write buildings?

options.label: No: web reads a building file and summaries only, last phase.
Full support.

reason: In line with D-B-05. A dev-only web store exists for checks.

question: Where do unassigned pages live?

options.label: Only in the dialog state.
As levelId null entries.

reason: sheets stays the one truth and each sheet has a level.

question: What does the elevation measure, and how long is a riser?

options.label: Finished floor height above a datum, mm, negative allowed. Column: Floor-to-floor length.
Pipe length with offsets.
